title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at Minor DKL Food Group (Brisbane, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Who is Minor DKL Food Group? Minor DKL Food Group (MDKL) is a leading Australian retail food franchisor, with brands including The Coffee Club, Ribs & Rumps Restaurants and Coffee Hit. We hold 460 restaurants in 6 countries, employing more than 8,000 staff and annual turnover exceeding $500 million. MDKL is also the majority owner of Veneziano Coffee Roasters, a leading speciality coffee roaster supplying wholesale and retail customers throughout Australia from roasting facilities in Melbourne and Brisbane. What is the role? Reporting to the Business Insights Manager, your role will primarily see you providing financial and commercial insights to a broad range of stakeholders, using customer transaction data. This is a newly created position, providing opportunity for a creatively minded and passionate Business Analyst to work in a dynamic and results focused organisation. Other tasks include but are not limited to: Drive actionable insights to support marketing calendar and promotion analysis Weekly monitoring and analysis of sales results Partner with business to drive commercial outcomes from both revenue and cost management perspective Make presentations to business Drive continuous improvement of deliverables by staying up-to-date on industry trends and technology advances This role is based at our Corporate Support Office in South Brisbane. What skills and knowledge do I need? We are looking for a resilient, commercially minded and technologically focused individual who has the drive to take on a busy role, learn quickly and strive for continuous improvement. You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced corporate environment and possess strong communication and interpersonal skills. As well as having a confident and positive personality, you will possess: Tertiary qualifications in Business or Information Technology Between 3 and 5 years of previous experience as a Business Analyst in a commercial environment; A proven track record in implementing data driven actionable insights; Experience in an FMCG or Retail environment is preferred; Advanced skills in Excel, and previous use of business intelligence tools such as PowerBI, Tableau or Qlikview; Skills in programming languages such as R or Python would be a distinct advantage; Attributes such as innovative and reliable, with a desire to transition towards data science and AI. What's in it for you? MDKL is an exciting, Brisbane based organisation, and we offer you: An opportunity to work with a supportive and friendly team; A competitive remuneration package; Regular team building and corporate events; A comprehensive employee benefits program including Purchased Leave, discounted health insurance and access to a subsidised training and development program; Coffee machine on site – we have 'Excellent' coffee on tap! Opportunity for career advancement as our organisation expands locally and globally. How do I apply? You are invited to submit your resume, including a covering letter through the link below.
